title: Mesh / istiod & ztunnel
description: Istio ambient control plane (istiod), the node's ztunnel and istio-cni: proxies connected, pushes, rejects, convergence, certificates, ztunnel xDS/traffic. Curated for this lab; see docs/dashboards/networking.md.

list.name: Istio config changed
list.textFormat: istiod processed Istio/Gateway API config events

panels.title: How to read this dashboard
panels.description: Reading guide for this dashboard.

options.content:
**What this is.** Istio runs in **ambient** mode: no sidecars. **istiod** (control plane) watches Kubernetes and Istio/Gateway API
objects and pushes configuration (xDS) to every proxy — today the two gateway Envoys (`public-istio`, `mcp-istio`) and the
node's **ztunnel** (L4 mTLS tunnel, one per node). **istio-cni** sets up traffic redirection into ztunnel for enrolled pods.
istiod is also the mesh certificate authority (workload certificates).

**Current state:** no namespace is labelled `istio.io/dataplane-mode=ambient`, so ztunnel proxies no workload (0 active proxies)
and the traffic panels of the ztunnel row are empty by design. They fill as soon as a namespace is enrolled.

**Healthy looks like:** istiod UP, connected proxies = 3 (2 gateways + ztunnel), xDS rejects 0, push convergence p99 well below
1 s, config validation failures 0, ztunnel xDS connected and not reconnecting in loops.

**When something goes red:** rejects/push errors → `istioctl analyze -A` and istiod logs (a bad VirtualService/HTTPRoute);
proxies disconnected → istiod pod/restarts, then `istioctl proxy-status`; root CA < 1 year → plan CA rotation.
Official dashboards (Istio Control Plane, Ztunnel, Mesh) are next to this one. Details: `docs/dashboards/networking.md`.

panels.title: istiod
panels.description: Is istiod scraped and alive (`up`, ServiceMonitor istiod)? DOWN = no config pushes and no new workload certificates; existing proxies keep their last config.

panels.title: Connected proxies
panels.description: xDS clients connected to istiod (pilot_xds, https://istio.io/latest/docs/reference/commands/pilot-discovery/#metrics). Expected here: 3 (public-istio, mcp-istio, ztunnel). Fewer = a proxy lost its control-plane connection.

panels.title: xDS rejects (range)
panels.description: Config pushes that a proxy NACKed in the time range (pilot_total_xds_rejects, https://istio.io/latest/docs/reference/commands/pilot-discovery/#metrics; 'Push Errors' panel of the Istio Control Plane dashboard https://github.com/istio/istio/blob/1.30.8/manifests/addons/dashboards/pilot.libsonnet). The series only exists after the first reject, hence `or vector(0)`.

panels.title: Push convergence p99
panels.description: 99th percentile time between a config change and proxies receiving it (pilot_proxy_convergence_time, https://istio.io/latest/docs/reference/commands/pilot-discovery/#metrics). Sub-second is normal for a lab this size.

panels.title: ztunnel
panels.description: Is the node's ztunnel scraped and alive (PodMonitor ztunnel, port 15020)? DOWN with ambient workloads = their traffic breaks.

panels.title: Ambient workloads (ztunnel proxies)
panels.description: Workloads ztunnel is currently proxying (workload_manager_active_proxy_count, https://github.com/istio/istio/blob/1.30.8/manifests/addons/dashboards/ztunnel.libsonnet). 0 today: no namespace is enrolled in ambient. Pending proxies > 0 for long = enrolment stuck (istio-cni).

panels.title: Mesh root CA: days left
panels.description: Days until istiod's self-signed root certificate expires (citadel_server_root_cert_expiry_timestamp, https://istio.io/latest/docs/reference/commands/pilot-discovery/#metrics). Default lifetime is 10 years; workload certs are re-issued daily from it.

panels.title: xDS pushes by type
panels.description: Pushes per second from istiod, by xDS type (pilot_xds_pushes, as in the Istio Control Plane dashboard https://github.com/istio/istio/blob/1.30.8/manifests/addons/dashboards/pilot.libsonnet): cds clusters, lds listeners, rds routes, eds endpoints, sds secrets, wds/wads ambient workloads/addresses for ztunnel. Bursts follow deployments/rollouts; constant pushes = something flapping (pod restarting, endpoints churn).

panels.title: Push errors & rejects
panels.description: Pushes that proxies NACKed (pilot_total_xds_rejects, by type) and istiod internal push errors (pilot_total_xds_internal_errors) — the 'Push Errors' panel of the official dashboard (https://github.com/istio/istio/blob/1.30.8/manifests/addons/dashboards/pilot.libsonnet). Should stay at 0; a reject means a proxy refused config, usually after an invalid route/policy.

panels.title: Proxy convergence time
panels.description: p50/p99 delay between a config change and the proxy receiving it (pilot_proxy_convergence_time, https://istio.io/latest/docs/reference/commands/pilot-discovery/#metrics). Grows with debounce, number of proxies and istiod CPU starvation.

panels.title: Config & registry events
panels.description: Kubernetes events istiod processes, as in the 'Events' panel of the official dashboard (https://github.com/istio/istio/blob/1.30.8/manifests/addons/dashboards/pilot.libsonnet): pilot_k8s_cfg_events (Istio/Gateway API config: HTTPRoute, Gateway, AuthorizationPolicy…) and pilot_k8s_reg_events (Services, EndpointSlices, Pods). What is changing in the cluster that triggers pushes?

panels.title: Config validation (webhook)
panels.description: Istio config accepted/rejected by istiod's validating webhook (galley_validation_passed/failed, 'Validation' panel of the official dashboard https://github.com/istio/istio/blob/1.30.8/manifests/addons/dashboards/pilot.libsonnet). Failures are kubectl/Argo CD applies of invalid Istio resources — Argo CD would show the sync error.

panels.title: Config problems detected
panels.description: Gauges istiod sets when it sees inconsistent config (https://istio.io/latest/docs/reference/commands/pilot-discovery/#metrics): listener conflicts (pilot_conflict_*), services without endpoints (pilot_eds_no_instances), endpoints without pods (pilot_k8s_endpoints_with_no_pods), duplicate clusters/domains. 0 is ideal; non-zero points at a Service selecting no pods or two routes claiming the same host/port.

panels.title: Workload certificates issued
panels.description: Certificate signing requests received and certificates issued by istiod's CA (citadel_server_csr_count, citadel_server_success_cert_issuance_count, https://istio.io/latest/docs/reference/commands/pilot-discovery/#metrics). Each proxy renews its cert periodically; CSRs without issuances = CA errors.

panels.title: istiod memory & CPU
panels.description: Working-set memory and CPU of the istiod `discovery` container, like 'Memory/CPU Usage' in the official dashboard (https://github.com/istio/istio/blob/1.30.8/manifests/addons/dashboards/pilot.libsonnet). Limit is 1 GiB (helm-charts/istio/istiod).

panels.title: Push queue time
panels.description: How long a proxy waited in istiod's push queue before being served (pilot_proxy_queue_time, https://istio.io/latest/docs/reference/commands/pilot-discovery/#metrics). High values with low CPU = debounce; with high CPU = istiod undersized.

panels.title: ztunnel xDS messages by type
panels.description: xDS messages ztunnel receives from istiod by resource type (istio_xds_message_total; 'XDS Pushes' in the official Ztunnel dashboard https://github.com/istio/istio/blob/1.30.8/manifests/addons/dashboards/ztunnel.libsonnet): Address = workloads/services it must know, Authorization = AuthorizationPolicies.

panels.title: ztunnel xDS connection terminations
panels.description: Times ztunnel's xDS stream to istiod ended, by reason (istio_xds_connection_terminations_total; 'XDS Connections' in https://github.com/istio/istio/blob/1.30.8/manifests/addons/dashboards/ztunnel.libsonnet). Occasional Reconnect is normal (istiod rotates streams ~every 30 min); ConnectionError bursts = istiod unreachable.

panels.title: ztunnel file descriptors
panels.description: Open vs max file descriptors of ztunnel (process_open_fds/process_max_fds; 'Resource Usage' in https://github.com/istio/istio/blob/1.30.8/manifests/addons/dashboards/ztunnel.libsonnet). Each proxied connection uses sockets; approaching max = connections refused.

panels.title: ztunnel TCP connections
panels.description: TCP connections opened (+) / closed (−) per second through ztunnel (istio_tcp_connections_opened/closed_total, https://istio.io/latest/docs/reference/config/metrics/; 'Connections' in https://github.com/istio/istio/blob/1.30.8/manifests/addons/dashboards/ztunnel.libsonnet). **Empty until a namespace joins the ambient mesh** (label `istio.io/dataplane-mode=ambient`, https://istio.io/latest/docs/ambient/usage/add-workloads/): today no workload is enrolled, so ztunnel carries no traffic and exports no istio_tcp_* series.

panels.title: ztunnel bytes by destination
panels.description: Bytes per second carried by ztunnel per destination workload (istio_tcp_sent/received_bytes_total, https://istio.io/latest/docs/reference/config/metrics/; 'Bytes Transmitted' in https://github.com/istio/istio/blob/1.30.8/manifests/addons/dashboards/ztunnel.libsonnet). **Empty until a namespace joins the ambient mesh** (label `istio.io/dataplane-mode=ambient`, https://istio.io/latest/docs/ambient/usage/add-workloads/): today no workload is enrolled, so ztunnel carries no traffic and exports no istio_tcp_* series.

panels.title: ztunnel memory & CPU
panels.description: Working-set memory and CPU of the ztunnel container (cAdvisor; 'Memory/CPU Usage' in https://github.com/istio/istio/blob/1.30.8/manifests/addons/dashboards/ztunnel.libsonnet).

panels.title: CNI installed
panels.description: istio_cni_install_ready: 1 when the istio-cni plugin is installed in the node's CNI config (https://istio.io/latest/docs/ambient/architecture/traffic-redirection/). 0 = new pods in ambient namespaces won't be redirected. **Pending scrape**: PodMonitor istio-cni added in helm-charts/istio/istio-raw; data appears once it is synced.

panels.title: CNI agent ↔ ztunnel
panels.description: ztunnel_connected: 1 when the istio-cni node agent has its control connection to ztunnel, used to hand over enrolled pods' network namespaces (https://istio.io/latest/docs/ambient/architecture/traffic-redirection/). **Pending scrape**: PodMonitor istio-cni added in helm-charts/istio/istio-raw; data appears once it is synced.

panels.title: CNI node agent reconcile events
panels.description: Pod events reconciled by the istio-cni node agent, by type add/update/delete (nodeagent_reconcile_events_total). It moves with every pod change in the cluster (the agent checks each pod for ambient enrolment); flat while pods churn = agent stuck. **Pending scrape**: PodMonitor istio-cni added in helm-charts/istio/istio-raw; data appears once it is synced.
